description: Return ranked cached products for a published category. Unknown or unpublished slugs return 404. A renamed slug returns 200 with redirect_to; request that current slug. An empty category returns found: false, noindex: true and products: []. Otherwise found is true; total counts the products in this response, not all marketplace matches. Cache-only.

slug.description: A published browse category slug, e.g. mobile-phones — the slug of an entry from /api/public/browse (MCP tool lianex_browse).

name: lianex_browse_by_slug

BrowseCard.description: A ranked category product card. Its fields differ from product detail; offers is a count of grouped offers.

bucket.description: The condition bucket this card landed in.
bucket.title: Bucket

from_price.description: Lowest price across the grouped offers.
from_price.title: From Price

offers.description: Number of grouped offers represented by this card. Product detail instead uses offers for a list.
offers.title: Offers

provider.description: The marketplace routing token — build the `/p/` permalink from it. Added by the endpoint, not by the card projection.
provider.title: Provider

reason.description: Why the ranker placed this card here.
reason.title: Reason

BrowseCard.title: BrowseCard

BrowseCategoryPage.description: Cached products for a published category. found: false means no cached products are available; products is empty and noindex is true.

found.description: `false` means we hold NO cached listings — not that the category is unknown.
found.title: Found

h1.description: The page's H1, which may be a keyword-intent variant of `name`.
h1.title: H1

noindex.description: `true` on the soft-empty page, so it is never indexed.
noindex.title: Noindex

qualifier.description: The page's keyword qualifier within its category (e.g. `gaming`), or empty for a whole-category page. The in-app Browse hand-off sends the category id plus only this text.
qualifier.title: Qualifier

siblings.description: The other published categories, for nav.
siblings.title: Siblings

total.description: Number of products in this response, not a catalogue-wide match total.
total.title: Total

updated_at.description: Freshest cached listing in the category, or `null`.
updated_at.title: Updated At

BrowseCategoryPage.title: BrowseCategoryPage

SlugRedirect.description: The requested address has a current canonical slug. This JSON response uses status 200. Request the returned slug on the same endpoint.

redirect_to.description: The slug to follow. Not a URL — a slug.
redirect_to.title: Redirect To

SlugRedirect.title: SlugRedirect

outputSchema.title: Response 200 Public Browse Category Api Public Browse  Slug  Get

title: Cached products in one published category
